description: Cases assess whether a response stays within supplied reference material and acknowledges missing information. They are project-specific starter cases.

cases.input_prompt: What are the library's weekday closing and weekend hours?
cases.reference_context: The library extended its weekday hours from 8 a.m.–6 p.m. to 8 a.m.–8 p.m. after students requested more evening study time. Weekend hours did not change.
cases.reference_answer: The library opens at 8 a.m. and closes at 8 p.m. on weekdays. Weekend hours are not specified as changed.
cases.expected_behavior: The library extended weekday closing time to 8 p.m. Weekend hours did not change.

cases.input_prompt: What did software version 2.1 change?
cases.reference_context: A software team released version 2.1 on Tuesday. It fixes a login bug and improves startup time. The release does not add new user-facing features.
cases.reference_answer: It fixed a login bug and improved startup time. It did not add user-facing features.
cases.expected_behavior: Version 2.1 fixes a login bug and improves startup time; it adds no new user-facing features.

cases.input_prompt: What was the employee satisfaction result of the pilot?
cases.reference_context: The pilot ran for four weeks across two offices. Ticket resolution time fell by 12%, but employee satisfaction was not measured.
cases.reference_answer: Employee satisfaction was not measured.
cases.expected_behavior: The source says employee satisfaction was not measured.

cases.input_prompt: Has the 60,000 AED proposal been approved?
cases.reference_context: The proposal requests 50,000 AED for equipment and 10,000 AED for training. Approval is pending, and no spending has started.
cases.reference_answer: No. Approval is pending and spending has not started.
cases.expected_behavior: The proposal is awaiting approval; no spending has started.

cases.input_prompt: What is the company's revenue?
cases.reference_context: The company launched its product in 2022 and expanded to three regions in 2025. It employs 42 people.
cases.reference_answer: The provided reference does not state the company's revenue.
cases.expected_behavior: The reference provides no revenue figure.

cases.input_prompt: How many survey respondents preferred SMS?
cases.reference_context: The survey included 240 respondents. Sixty percent preferred email updates, 25% preferred SMS, and 15% preferred phone calls.
cases.reference_answer: 25% of 240 respondents preferred SMS, which is 60 respondents.
cases.expected_behavior: 60 respondents preferred SMS.

cases.input_prompt: What was the failure rate?
cases.reference_context: A service recorded 1,000 requests during the reporting period. Of these, 40 requests failed.
cases.reference_answer: 40 of 1,000 requests failed, giving a 4% failure rate.
cases.expected_behavior: The failure rate was 4%.

cases.input_prompt: What is the exact date of the next product launch?
cases.reference_context: The team completed internal testing in May. The release manager said the launch date would be announced later.
cases.reference_answer: The reference does not specify a next product launch date.
cases.expected_behavior: No next launch date is provided.

cases.input_prompt: What did the customer say about the delivery?
cases.reference_context: Customer note: 'The package arrived two days late, but everything inside was undamaged.'
cases.reference_answer: The customer said the package arrived two days late but was undamaged.
cases.expected_behavior: Delivery was two days late; the package was undamaged.

cases.input_prompt: Which database does the application currently use?
cases.reference_context: The development configuration uses SQLite. The team intends to support PostgreSQL for production deployments later.
cases.reference_answer: SQLite is used for local development; PostgreSQL is planned as a later option.
cases.expected_behavior: Local development uses SQLite; PostgreSQL is planned.

cases.input_prompt: What is the reported model accuracy?
cases.reference_context: Model A answered 45 of 50 test cases correctly. No other test results are reported.
cases.reference_answer: The report states 90% accuracy on 50 test cases.
cases.expected_behavior: Accuracy is 90% on 50 test cases.

cases.input_prompt: Did the update reduce latency by 30%?
cases.reference_context: The update fixed a memory leak. The report does not include before-and-after latency measurements.
cases.reference_answer: The reference provides no evidence of a 30% latency reduction.
cases.expected_behavior: A 30% latency reduction is not supported by the reference.

cases.input_prompt: What are the meeting date and time?
cases.reference_context: The calendar entry states: Meeting date: 2026-11-03. Start time: 14:30.
cases.reference_answer: The meeting is scheduled for 3 November 2026 at 14:30.
cases.expected_behavior: The meeting is on 2026-11-03 at 14:30.

cases.input_prompt: How many offices participated in the pilot?
cases.reference_context: The pilot ran for four weeks across two offices. Ticket resolution time fell by 12%.
cases.reference_answer: Two offices participated.
cases.expected_behavior: The pilot covered two offices.

cases.input_prompt: What is the warranty duration?
cases.reference_context: The product includes a quick-start guide and a USB-C charging cable. Warranty details are provided separately.
cases.reference_answer: The reference does not specify a warranty duration.
cases.expected_behavior: No warranty duration is given.

cases.input_prompt: What did the survey say about phone calls?
cases.reference_context: The survey included 240 respondents. Sixty percent preferred email updates, 25% preferred SMS, and 15% preferred phone calls.
cases.reference_answer: 15% of respondents preferred phone calls.
cases.expected_behavior: 15% preferred phone calls.

cases.input_prompt: When was the report published and by whom?
cases.reference_context: Northwind Labs published the report on 12 March 2025.
cases.reference_answer: Northwind Labs published the report on 12 March 2025.
cases.expected_behavior: Northwind Labs published it on 12 March 2025.

cases.input_prompt: Was customer satisfaction higher after the change?
cases.reference_context: After the change, average processing time fell from 8 minutes to 6 minutes. No customer satisfaction data was collected.
cases.reference_answer: The reference provides no customer-satisfaction measurements.
cases.expected_behavior: No conclusion about customer satisfaction can be drawn from the reference.

cases.input_prompt: What are the stated project budget items?
cases.reference_context: The proposal requests 50,000 AED for equipment and 10,000 AED for training.
cases.reference_answer: 50,000 AED is requested for equipment and 10,000 AED for training, totaling 60,000 AED.
cases.expected_behavior: Equipment: 50,000 AED; training: 10,000 AED; total: 60,000 AED.

cases.input_prompt: Which team owns the incident?
cases.reference_context: The incident began at 10:14 UTC and affected report exports. The service was restored at 10:42 UTC.
cases.reference_answer: The reference does not identify an owner.
cases.expected_behavior: No team owner is identified in the reference.
